title: Group: legal entity register and organization charts
source_system: Corporate secretary's entity management system
what_it_shows: Cris Santos Company Holdings, Inc. is an SEC registrant. No subsidiary holds a bank charter, an insurance license or a New York license. Organization charts show the Group CISO, division CISOs in Cloud Software and Payments and Payroll, a security and compliance lead and a federal contracts compliance officer in Technology Consulting, group internal audit reporting to the board audit committee, and the disclosure committee

source_system: Group HR information system (SYS-G4)

title: Group: SYS-G1 authentication and sign-in policy export
source_system: Group identity platform admin console (SYS-G1)
what_it_shows: Single sign-on with MFA is required for every workforce identity in SYS-G1; administrators use phishing-resistant hardware keys. Passwords follow SP 800-63B with breached-password blocking; accounts lock after 10 failed attempts; the sign-in page shows the system use notification; federation uses replay-resistant protocols and certificate-based authentication validates the certificate path. The about 2,600 acquired-firm consultants sign in through the acquired firm's own identity provider, not SYS-G1

title: Group: SYS-G1 identity governance export
source_system: Identity governance module (SYS-G1)
what_it_shows: Joiner-mover-leaver workflows run from HR events; temporary and emergency accounts expire automatically (break-glass accounts after 8 hours); workforce accounts inactive for 35 days are disabled; high-risk accounts can be disabled within 1 hour of a SOC or HR determination; identifiers are never reused. The export covers workforce identities; cloud service identities and their keys are outside its scope

title: Group: Q1 2026 access certification results
source_system: Identity governance module (SYS-G1)
what_it_shows: Quarterly campaigns were completed for group and division applications and for privileged roles. The campaign scope does not include implementation-partner roles granted inside Workforce Cloud customer tenants, cloud service identities, or accounts in the acquired firm's identity provider

title: Group: privileged access management configuration and logs
source_system: Privileged access management console (SYS-G1)
what_it_shows: Privileged cloud and database roles are granted just in time with approval and session recording; administrators use separate privileged identities; privileged use is logged to the SIEM. WCP accounts have had no standing administrators since 2025 (42 were removed); access into the cardholder data environment goes through PAM with MFA. No vendor remote maintenance path into production is configured

title: Group: endpoint management and device compliance report
source_system: Endpoint management console (SYS-G1)
what_it_shows: Group-managed laptops have full-disk encryption, a 10-minute screen lock, remote wipe, device certificates and approval-only software installation; only compliant devices reach WCP administration. Remote workforce access uses device-trust checks and single sign-on, with no network VPN path into production. Laptops are wiped and certified at disposal. The acquired firm's laptops are not enrolled

title: Group: EDR coverage report
source_system: EDR console (SYS-G2)
what_it_shows: EDR is active on group-managed endpoints, servers, cloud hosts and container nodes, including the payroll engine and cardholder data environment hosts. The about 2,600 acquired-firm laptops run the acquired firm's legacy antivirus and do not report to the group console

title: Group: SIEM data source inventory and detection rules
source_system: Group SIEM (SYS-G2)
what_it_shows: A 24x7 SOC correlates cloud control-plane, identity, application, cardholder data environment and consulting integration-environment logs; log pipeline failures alert the SOC; threat advisories are processed daily; workforce email passes a filtering gateway. Behavior analytics cover workforce accounts only. The source list has no object-level read events for the WCP export bucket and no rule for cloud key use from a new network. The acquired firm's network is not a source; it is monitored by its own firewall

title: Group: SOC case export, playbooks and exercise reports, April 2025 to March 2026
source_system: Group case management system (SYS-G2); SOC document library
what_it_shows: Incidents are tracked in the SOC case system with one severity scale and division liaisons; playbooks cover disabling high-risk accounts. Technical playbooks were exercised each quarter and responders trained yearly. No exercise of cross-division notification is recorded

title: Group: incident response plan v2025 and notification matrix
source_system: Group SOC document library; Group legal

It does not list the FTC Safeguards notice, bank-designated contacts for bank customers, the 48-hour terms negotiated by enterprise customers, hospital BAA notice terms, the sponsor banks' 24-hour notice or FAR 52.204-25 reporting, and no exercise of it across divisions is recorded
